scope: Host regression of cached-status privacy helper; no runtime acceptance
changed_behavior: Cached-track content ID is captured with the retained detach proof instead of read from the mutable load ledger.
Pending and failed replacement attempts retain private classification for the cached track.
Simulated proof retirement permits native and external replacement reporting even with the same content ID.

coverage: Submitted pending and completed exact detach proof
Pending and failed same-content native replacement
Simulated proof retirement and native/external same-content status
Wrong controller/deck/owner, zero connection/reference/epoch, invalid ticket/phase/submission, truncated packet

limits: The cached-status test simulates native success/unload by clearing proof validity; it does not execute the native callbacks.
Generated overlay must populate the new cached-proof content_id field before this adapter can be used.
No new emulator, physical controller, audio, or real CDJ acceptance.
No complete 1152-byte payload audit yet; observer --status-payloads enables a subsequent local audit.
A cached-origin packet serialized before proof retirement but sent afterward remains an unobserved ordering risk; content ID alone cannot distinguish native same-content replacement.
Explicit private member source tuples remain covered by the separate configured-source mask.
